families.notes: Charge utility (snare/stun on the pull). NPC 547, level 16-17 Boar in Westfall (Alliance-side). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic.
Fast attack speed; pushes back casters. NPC 5807, level 10 Rare cat in The Barrens (Horde-side rare spawn). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic.

Screech reduces the melee attack power of nearby enemies (AoE) — strong WSG teamfight utility. NPC 1194, level 15-16 Carrion Bird in Loch Modan. Replaces the seed's wind-serpent (Deviate Stinglash): wind serpents are untameable at 19 — the lowest tameable is ~level 25, and Deviate Stinglash is an Elite instance mob (elites/level-25 pets are out of reach). Owls (e.g. Strigid Screecher, Teldrassil) also carry Screech. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic and Petopia Classic.

xpNote: Pets need only ~25% of the XP a player needs, so a 19 can level a full pet stable within budget. Pets gain NO XP from quest turn-ins — only the player does. Sync pets to your level BEFORE turning in gear quests or you'll out-level them.
abilityNote: Ability-shop while taming: tame temporary pets to learn ability ranks (e.g. Bite Rank 3, Claw Rank 3) before taming the keeper — learned abilities persist on the hunter.
budgetNote: At level 18 with three level-18 pets you have roughly a 6,000 XP surplus for the few required gear quests before hitting 19. Sync pets first, then turn in.
